name: Universal Infinite Scope and Direction Principle
authority: NONE — DERIVED TRUTH. This programme legislates nothing. It is not superior to CMG-000001 (law owner), UCIC-001 (lifecycle owner) or CEP-009 (evolution authority); it declares no lifecycle stage, opens no registry, consumes no counter and issues no identifier. It measures a property those instruments already claim — that scope, direction, relationship and evolution capacity are unbounded — including for itself.
$why_this_exists: The infinite-scope property was asserted, never computed. 03-CONSTITUTIONAL-UNBOUNDEDNESS-CERTIFICATION.md certifies 16 axes unbounded and 04-HIDDEN-FINITE-ASSUMPTION-CERTIFICATION.md certifies 23 axes free of finite assumption, but the latter states its own limit in §4: 'An exhaustive line-by-line proof of absence across all 431 concepts was NOT performed. ASSUMPTION: no hidden finite assumption exists beyond those reviewed', with residual risk confined to the realization layers. A property asserted in a dated document decays; a property computed on every verification run does not. This declaration holds the laws as DATA so the engine contains no law text and no enumeration member, the discipline engine/context/constitution.py applies to CXL-01..12 and engine/object_birth/contract.py applies to UOBC-L-01..08.
$not_a_second_authority: CAA-INV-04 recognises a second identity authority by the counter it advances; the declared mint marker is 'category_seq'. This programme holds no counter and no marker. CAA-INV-07 refuses any instrument declaring a rival object model; this programme declares none. AUE-BND-06 refuses declaring lifecycle stages; this programme declares none. Its subject is a property of instruments, never an instrument.

principle.statement: Infinite and unlimited scopes, infinite and unlimited directions, infinite and unlimited relationships, and infinite and unlimited evolution capability apply to every object, capability, universe, registry, dictionary, relationship, lifecycle, constitution, engine and technology in UCOS, and to this principle itself.
principle.$standing_rationale: Read as an authority above the lifecycle, the principle would install a rival supreme instrument over CMG-000001 and UCIC-001 — refused under CAA-INV-04, CAA-INV-07 and CMG Art LXXVI.6 (expansion by reinterpretation). Read as a property every layer must exhibit, it applies to the authority stack without displacing it, which is the only reading that is both faithful to the mission and admissible under the constitution.
principle.prohibited_condition: UNDISCLOSED CLOSURE — an enumeration closed in code or data while nothing states what closes it or how a member is admitted.
principle.$why_not_no_closed_enumerations: That formulation would be false and would be disabled within a cycle. engine/uckp/facets.py closes 33 facets on purpose, and its own docstring gives the reason: 'The enumeration is closed on purpose while the vocabularies inside facets are open. Adding a thirty-fourth facet is a constitutional amendment ... Adding a new knowledge kind, authority tier, persistence technology or relationship class is registration, and registration must never require an amendment.' Closure of the QUESTION set is what keeps the ANSWER sets open. The failure mode worth prohibiting is silence about closure, not closure.

laws.title: Scope Expansion Capacity
laws.statement: ScopeExpansionCapacity(object) = infinity. No enumeration claims completeness silently: every closed enumeration discloses both the invariant that closes it and the path by which a member is admitted.

laws.title: Direction Expansion Capacity
laws.statement: DirectionExpansionCapacity(object) = infinity. The relationship type space is pattern-constrained, never enumeration-constrained, and a freeform admission label exists so a new direction requires no schema edit.

laws.title: The Principle Inherits Its Own Lifecycle
laws.statement: This principle is subject to its own laws, declares no independent lifecycle, and holds a birth record like any other object.

laws.title: Lifecycle Applies To Itself
laws.statement: The constitutional lifecycle stage graph declares itself open and admits a stage without an engine change, and its executable projection does not diverge from it.

laws.title: Evolution Applies To Itself
laws.statement: The evolution cycle has no terminal stage and returns to its first stage from its last. Evolution cannot exempt itself from continuation.

laws.title: Relationship Model Expands
laws.statement: EvolutionCapacity(relationship) = infinity and ExpansionCapacity(RelationshipModel) = infinity: the relationship vocabularies admit a new term by registration, without amendment, without mutating the existing vocabulary, and at every tier including the tier that classifies relationship models.

laws.title: No Active Permanent Freeze
laws.statement: No permanence phrase appears as an active lifecycle declaration in the scanned roots. Every occurrence is a disclosed, classified site, no site is classified A, and no historical, identity-bearing or constitutional site changes its occurrence count.

laws.title: Baseline Temporal Qualification
laws.statement: Every declared baseline surface either carries a temporal coordinate that parses under CMG-000002, or discloses that it does not and names the owner the qualification is deferred to. Undisclosed non-conformance is refused.

laws.title: Technology Is An Evolutionary State
laws.statement: No runtime dependency is pinned, the language requirement is a floor with no ceiling, and every verification-toolchain pin is disclosed with a reason. A technology version is an evolutionary state, never a constitutional truth.

laws.title: Capability Seed Openness
laws.statement: The capability model is a seed, not a final universe: it declares itself non-final and every declared capability enumeration names its admission path.

$law_checks: Every law names a check that computes its own compliance. A law with no reachable check would be manual governance, so the contract refuses to construct itself if any check is missing, and refuses if a check is implemented but unclaimed by any law.

$disclosure_completeness: This list is itself open: it enumerates the closed enumerations located at baseline bb9c27d2 and is extended by appending an entry. ISD-L-01 measures that each entry names a closing invariant and an admission path, not that the list is exhaustive — a claim of exhaustiveness would be the very finite assumption the principle prohibits.

freeform_admission.$why: A front-matter row '| RELATES Federates | UMB-012 |' takes the token verbatim as the edge type and materialises its inverse. A new direction therefore requires no schema edit, no config edit and no engine change — the zero-cost admission path.

lifecycle_openness.$why: The stage graph is the one place a lifecycle could silently become finite. manifest.open and closed_enumeration are the declared property; verify_manifest_alignment is the proof that the executable projection has not drifted from it. Both are measured, because a declaration nobody checks and a projection nobody compares are the two halves of the same failure.

evolution_openness.$why: Article-14. is_terminal must return False for every declared stage and next_stage must return the first stage from the last, so the cycle is structurally incapable of ending. Measured over the whole cycle rather than sampled.

vocabularies.tier: relationship class — the tier that classifies relationship models

relationship_expansion.$why: Openness is proven by performing the extension in memory on every gate run, not by reading a comment that claims it. The probe asserts three things: the extended vocabulary contains the new term, the original does not, and the two are distinct objects — so extension is append-only AND non-mutating. Nothing is written to disk and the probe term is never registered.
relationship_expansion.$two_tiers_is_the_self_application: RELATIONSHIP_CLASS_VOCABULARY is a vocabulary of registers OF relationships. The same extended_with admits a term at either tier, so the relationship model already contains a model of relationship models and 'the relationship model can create new relationship models' holds by construction rather than by assertion.

classes.A: active lifecycle declaration forbidding future change with no channel named — inadmissible
classes.B: historical evidence — a record of a past state, preserved verbatim
classes.C: identity-bearing artifact — the phrase is in a registered name; a rename is an identity act
classes.D: constitutional meaning or declared vocabulary — normative text, or a legitimate member of a declared state machine
classes.E: commentary, citation or self-classification — including the registers whose purpose is to quote the vocabulary

freeze_scan.$count_enforcement_split: Classes B, C and D are records that must not change, so an exact occurrence count is the correct assertion. Class E files are the classification registers themselves, whose counts legitimately grow as they classify more; freezing them would fail the gate on documentation maintenance, and a gate that fires on documentation maintenance gets disabled rather than fixed — the GP-4 / GP-6 pattern this repository has already recorded twice. Regression enters through NEW sites, and there the ratchet is absolute.

$excluded_patterns.never change: EXCLUDED. Roughly 55 occurrences are identity-immutability invariants — the exact inverse of freeze semantics: UCKP-ART-05 'an identity, once minted, never changes', UIS-P-04, UVS-P-04, UOBC-L-07, ENG-L-04. engine/uckp/identity.py::require_unchanged fails closed on the property they state, and engine/tests/uckp/test_alignment.py plus platform/tests/test_constitutional_authority_alignment.py assert the wording verbatim. Including the pattern would flag the architecture's strongest guarantee as its worst defect.
$excluded_patterns.FROZEN as a bare token: EXCLUDED; only status ASSIGNMENTS are matched. engine/registry/models.py declares FROZEN as a member of the artifact status vocabulary and _CERTIFIED_STATUSES treats it as certified. CEP-007 Article VI defines FROZEN as a state WITH an outgoing transition to SUPERSEDED. A state named in a vocabulary is not a state claimed as terminal.

It holds engine-generated derived truth (rib.json corpus_status, ufep.json state, nine UGA registry projections) where a FROZEN value is a rendered consequence of a source status. Scanning it would measure the projection instead of the claim, and a hand edit there is drift the owning engine's gate already catches. Recorded as gap ISD-G-06.

baseline_temporal_requirement.$representation_neutrality: CMG-000002 §3.1 lists ten representations it DOES NOT MANDATE, including UTC, ISO 8601, Unix epoch, GPS, TAI, the Gregorian calendar, Earth time zones and leap seconds; §3.3 states 'No representation is more correct than another.' This law therefore requires a coordinate to be QUALIFIED — to name its reference system — and never requires a particular system.

surfaces.$note: Caller-supplied and clock-free; deliberately not an identity input, so a birth record replays byte-identically. The primary value is the repository history position, which is derivable rather than read from a clock.

Records temporality as the BOOLEAN date_recorded over bare calendar dates (2026-07-30, 2026-08-01). baseline_engine.py contains zero occurrences of temporal, TemporalCoordinate, datetime, utcnow or now(, and does not import engine/temporal/. Not retrofitted: BASELINE-REGISTRY.md states 'Records are added, never edited, renumbered, reclassified or withdrawn', and the registers are replay-gated on seal_sha256, so retrofitting would rewrite what was certified. The determined forward shape is that the NEXT appended baseline row carries a qualified coordinate.

The commit:<sha12> form is declared CONFORMING by GOVERNED-EVOLUTION-STATE-DETERMINATION.md §5 but is REFUSED by parse_qualified, which requires <type>:<identifier>@<version>#<primary>. One of the two formats that determination calls conforming conforms by prose, not by the executable contract.

Hard-coded ISO-8601 Earth UTC from ukb.py::_now — the original gap G1. Already recorded NON-CONFORMING by GOVERNED-EVOLUTION-STATE-DETERMINATION.md §5, and deliberately uncorrected there: first_seen is frozen at mint and append-only, so changing its representation would rewrite existing entries. Migration requires its own determination (F-5).

baseline_temporal_requirement.$why_disclosure_not_conformance: Requiring every baseline surface to already carry a qualified coordinate would fail on immutable history and be disabled within a cycle. The law instead refuses UNDISCLOSED non-conformance: a surface either parses, or names the owner it is deferred to and the gap it is recorded under. That is the difference between a gate and a wish.

technology_evolution.$runtime_rationale: TP-04 Vendor Neutrality of Core, TP-05 Least Sufficient Technology. dependencies = [] means there is no runtime technology to be locked to.
technology_evolution.$version_rationale: A floor admits every future version; a ceiling forbids one. '>=3.12' is an evolutionary state. An upper bound, or an exact pin, would encode 'Technology X forever' — the condition CEP-007 II.2 and XXII.3 reserve out of constitutional jurisdiction.

technology_evolution.$pins_are_disclosed_not_forbidden: An undisclosed pin closes the gate. A disclosed pin with a reason is an evolutionary state under review, which is what the technology capability lifecycle requires and what a constitution may not forbid.

self_application.$subject_rationale: The principle that everything is subject to unlimited evolution cannot exempt the instrument that states it. ISD-L-03 measures that this declaration names itself here, so removing the self-subjection closes the gate.
self_application.$declares_authority_over_rationale: Empty by construction and measured empty. A non-empty value would make this an authority layer rather than a pervasive property, which is the reading §0 of the root determination refuses.

gate.hermetic: reads this declaration and declared files in the tree, imports located modules in-process, computes; reads no clock and no network, spawns no subprocess, and writes nothing anywhere including gitignored paths

exit_semantics.1: CLOSED — a law was measured and refused
exit_semantics.2: FAULT — no verdict could be reached

gate.$no_gate_flag: No --gate flag is declared. The gate is fail-closed by DEFAULT: the exit code is driven by the verdict, so there is no mode in which a refused law exits 0. A --gate flag that is accepted and never read would be the GP-4 defect recorded in GATE-PURITY-DETERMINATION.md, and the repository already carries two instances of it.
gate.$no_render_flag: No --render and no --replay are declared, because a gate that writes nothing has nothing to render and cannot drift.

It certifies nothing about the correctness, quality or constitutionality of any object, declares no baseline certified, and does not certify that the disclosure lists it carries are exhaustive — a claim of exhaustiveness would itself be the finite assumption the principle prohibits.
